ev.q: This report confirms high HIV incidence among these young men.
The prevalence of HIV infection was 7.2%
Incidence was annualized to units of percent per year.
HIV incidence was 2.6% overall, 3.5% among persons aged 20--22 years
YMS Phase I was a cross-sectional, multisite, venue-based sample survey of men aged 15--22 years

methods_quotes.q: Incidence was calculated using the number of persons with recent infections as the numerator
A specimen that was 3A11-reactive but 3A11-LS-nonreactive was categorized as a recent infection.
Incidence estimates were adjusted for HIV-positive specimens that were not tested by STARHS.
Incidence was annualized to units of percent per year.
the data were not weighted according to venue attendance
